mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Schedule (team season schedule, or league schedule for a date span)
Standings (league tables by conference and division)
Game (full summary per event id: box score, leaders, odds, win probability, plays)
Odds (sportsbook lines for events on the dates)
Rankings (polls and rankings: AP, Coaches, ATP, WTA, UFC)
mode.description: What to fetch. Every mode takes a list of leagues; schedule and roster use 'teams', game uses 'eventIds', scoreboard and odds use 'dates'.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: League codes, one per entry. Short codes: nfl, nba, wnba, mlb, nhl, ncaaf, ncaam, ncaaw, epl, laliga, bundesliga, seriea, ligue1, mls, ucl, uel, world-cup, soccer-all, atp, wta, pga, lpga, ufc, f1. Any other ESPN league as sport/league, e.g. soccer/ned.1, soccer/bra.1, golf/eur, racing/nascar-premier, cricket/8048. The README lists the codes.

dates.title: Dates
dates.description: For scoreboard, odds and league schedule. today, yesterday, tomorrow, a day (2026-10-11 or 20261011), a span (2026-10-01..2026-10-07 or 20261001-20261007, up to 366 days), a month (202610) or a year (2026). Days are resolved in 'timezone'. A span is fetched one day at a time; months and years are single requests and heavy for golf and tennis.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA zone used to resolve today/yesterday/tomorrow and to fill the dateLocal field. ESPN's own game days follow US Eastern time, so the default keeps 'today' aligned with espn.com.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: ESPN team ids or abbreviations (LAL, KC, ARS, 13). Required by roster mode; schedule mode returns these teams' season schedules; scoreboard and odds modes keep only events involving them. Prefix with a league to scope one entry: nba/LAL.

eventIds.title: Event ids
eventIds.description: Game mode. ESPN event ids as found in scoreboard rows or ESPN URLs, prefixed with the league when more than one league is given: nba/401902645, nfl/401772510, eng.1/401879268, ufc/600061541, pga/401850916, atp/959-2026. A full ESPN gamecast URL also works.

season.title: Season
season.description: Season year for standings, schedule and rankings (ESPN convention: the 2025-26 NBA season is 2026, the 2025 NFL season is 2025). Empty = current season.

seasonType.title: Season type
seasonType.description: 1 preseason, 2 regular season, 3 postseason, 4 off-season, for standings and schedule. Empty = ESPN default (regular season or the current phase).

groups.title: College group or conference id
groups.description: College leagues only. 80 = FBS (default for college football), 81 = FCS, 50 = Division I (default for college basketball), or a conference id such as 8 (SEC football). Applies to scoreboard, standings and teams.

statusFilter.title: Game status
statusFilter.description: Scoreboard, schedule and odds: keep events in these states only. Use ['in'] for a live feed, ['pre'] for upcoming games with lines.

includeBoxScore.title: Include box score
includeBoxScore.description: Game mode: team statistics and per-player statistics for each side (lineups, formation and substitutions for soccer).

includePlayByPlay.title: Include play-by-play
includePlayByPlay.description: Game mode: every play with period, clock, score, text and team (drives for football, key events and commentary for soccer). Large: a basketball game has 450-550 plays.

maxPlays.title: Maximum plays
maxPlays.description: Game mode with play-by-play: keep at most this many plays per game, from the start.

allOddsProviders.title: All sportsbooks
allOddsProviders.description: Odds mode: one extra request per event to ESPN's odds feed for every sportsbook ESPN lists (DraftKings, Bet365, live lines) with open, close and current values. Off = the featured line embedded in the scoreboard, one row per event, no extra requests.

includeTeamDetails.title: Team details
includeTeamDetails.description: Teams mode: one extra request per team for the home venue, current record, standing summary and next event.

maxResults.title: Maximum rows
maxResults.description: Stop after this many rows in total. In game mode it caps the number of event ids processed.
